title: Patchwork brand file
description: Input of `patchwork rebrand`: the brand applied to a FileMaker solution.

name.description: Brand name. The rewritten theme is renamed to it.

theme.description: Theme to rewrite, by display or internal name. Default: the theme most layouts use.

colors.description: Old hex color -> new hex color, without #. Applied to the theme and to local layout styles.

fonts.description: Old font -> new font, each written WindowsName,MacPostScriptName (e.g. Georgia,Georgia-Bold).

image.description: PNG path, relative to the brand file.

replace.description: Existing container shown on layouts, as Table::Field. Every layout object showing it gets the new logo.

field.description: Name of the global container field that holds the new logo.

width.description: Resize the PNG to this width in pixels (needs Pillow). The embedded logo must stay under about 28,000 base64 characters.
